nodes.name: PagerDuty Webhook
nodes.notes: Receives PagerDuty alert payload. In production: set your PagerDuty webhook URL to http://YOUR_N8N_HOST/webhook/pagerduty-webhook. For testing: use the mock trigger node instead.

nodes.name: Run Triage Agent (Python + Claude)
nodes.notes: UPDATE THE PATH: replace /path/to/ai-incident-triage-agent with your actual repo path. The agent calls Claude API, fetches logs and deploys, returns structured JSON.

nodes.name: Create Jira Ticket
nodes.notes: Setup: replace YOUR_DOMAIN with your Jira Cloud domain. Add Basic Auth credential: email + Jira API token (free at id.atlassian.net). Create project with key OPS.

nodes.name: Slack Alert
nodes.notes: Setup: add Slack credential (OAuth or Bot Token). Change #incidents to your channel. Free Slack allows incoming webhooks.
